name: fdm_common_5axis
machine_start_gcode:
; 5-axis start g-code (RepRapFirmware)
M83            ; extruder relative mode
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; set bed temp
M104 S[first_layer_temperature]     ; set nozzle temp
G28            ; home X Y Z B C
G90            ; absolute positioning
{if !virtual_5axis}G1 B-90 C0 F3600 ; level the rotary axes (B-90 = nozzle straight down, the homed pose)
{endif}M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; wait for bed
M109 S[first_layer_temperature]     ; wait for nozzle
G92 E0
machine_end_gcode:
M400           ; finish moves
G91            ; relative
G1 Z5 F600     ; lift
G90            ; absolute
{if !virtual_5axis}G1 B-90 C0 F3600 ; return rotary axes to the homed pose
{endif}M104 S0        ; nozzle off
M140 S0        ; bed off
M107           ; fan off
M84            ; motors off
